caption: First set-up step behind a cookie banner, inside the Access Evo shell: the bar reads TRIAL MODE and 14 days remaining before the trial expires; the user name and initials are hidden.
Business setup stage after entering Access Evo.
Welcome screen of the trial: 'Use demo data' is ticked by default; we left it on.
Add Product saved our test record ('Product created successfully'), with a two-line note containing quotation marks and an accent; the user name is hidden.
The product list shows our AIBM-001 / TEST Zoë Alpha with the accent intact, next to furniture demo rows; the user name is hidden.
The product list's Export menu offers PDF, CSV and XLSX on the trial; we did not download a file.
The subscribe flow's plan page: Core $399 and Pro $729 paid monthly, before add-ons and payment; we went no further. The user name is hidden.
